instruction.text: Read the postcard and fill in the missing parentheses.

atoms.a: Dear Mum, Last week, Tuesday, I visited Hastings in East Sussex. In my guide book, it said: “Make sure to visit the Shipwreck Museum, an archive of ships wrecked in the channel, when in Hastings.”I searched for a long time but couldn’t find it. Eventually, I asked someone for directions. The person told me, “Just turn left at the next crossing, and you’ll see the museum at the end of the road.”It was a long search, it took me three hours, but it was amazing when I got there!Lots of love,Kate
